builtin.description: Hooks that ship with cognia, merged under your own. Toggle any off; guards default off.

auto-context-loader.desc: Inject .cognia/agent-context.md as standing context at session start.
auto-context-loader.label: Auto context (session)

auto-context-loader-prompt.desc: Inject .cognia/agent-context.md as standing context on every prompt.
auto-context-loader-prompt.label: Auto context (prompt)

cost-quota-guard.desc: Deny a turn once the session token budget is exceeded.
cost-quota-guard.label: Token budget guard

pii-safety-guard.desc: Block a prompt that carries obvious PII or credentials.
pii-safety-guard.label: PII guard (prompt)

pii-safety-guard-tool.desc: Block a tool call whose input carries obvious PII or credentials.
pii-safety-guard-tool.label: PII guard (tool)

builtin.title: Built-in hooks

confirmSwitch.description: You have unsaved hook edits in the current scope. Switching scope will discard them.
confirmSwitch.title: Discard unsaved changes?

description: Run shell commands or send webhooks at lifecycle events. Stored in ~/.claude/settings.json (User scope) or .claude/settings.json under a project. The full settings document round-trips — unrelated keys are preserved.

claude.desc: Install forwarder hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json so every Claude Code session reports here. Fail-open: with Cognia closed they exit instantly.
claude.label: Claude Code hooks

codex.desc: Point ~/.codex/config.toml's notify at a forwarder. Observe-only — one event per completed turn, no trust step.
codex.label: Codex notify

fleet.description: Watch and control coding agents launched anywhere on this machine (terminals, editors) — not just ones started by Cognia.

island.desc: Dynamic-Island-style always-on-top strip showing live agent sessions near the notch.
island.label: Island overlay

monitor.desc: Local event ingress for external agent hooks. Runs on the companion server, loopback only.
monitor.label: Fleet monitoring

opencode.desc: Install a plugin into ~/.config/opencode/plugin. Observe sessions and approve/deny permissions from the island.
opencode.label: OpenCode plugin

fleet.title: Agent fleet monitor

group.matcherHint: Tool-name regex, pipe alternation, or empty / '*' to match every event.
group.matcherPlaceholder: Bash|Write or .* (leave empty to match all)

handler.webhookUnsupported: Webhooks aren't executed by the desktop runtime yet — this handler is saved but won't fire.

noGroupsForEvent: No groups configured for {event}. Click "Add group" to attach a matcher.
noTriggerNote: This event is recognised and saved, but the runtime has no trigger source for it yet — hooks configured here will not fire.
title: Lifecycle hooks
